\subsection{How to Load and Build Networks}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:how-to-load-and-build-networks}}\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Goal:} Create multilayer networks from scratch or load them from files.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Prerequisites:} Basic Python knowledge. For conceptual background, see {\hyperref[\detokenize{concepts/py3plex_core_model::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{The py3plex Core Model}}}}.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Start from the format you already have: add edges directly if you are prototyping, or load from files/dataframes when your data is already tabular. The examples below always build a \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{network}} object you can reuse in later steps.


\subsubsection{Creating Networks from Scratch}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:creating-networks-from-scratch}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use these options when you want to assemble a small network interactively or generate synthetic structures.


\paragraph{Method 1: Add Edges Directly (Recommended)}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:method-1-add-edges-directly-recommended}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The simplest approach—nodes are created automatically when you add edges.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create empty network}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add edges in list format}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Format: [source\PYGZus{}node, source\PYGZus{}layer, target\PYGZus{}node, target\PYGZus{}layer, weight]}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Carol}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{colleagues}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{colleagues}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{colleagues}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Dave}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{colleagues}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{list}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Verify}
\PYG{n}{stats} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{basic\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
Number of nodes: 6
Number of edges: 4
Number of unique node IDs (across all layers): 4
Nodes per layer:
  Layer \PYGZsq{}friends\PYGZsq{}: 3 nodes
  Layer \PYGZsq{}colleagues\PYGZsq{}: 3 nodes
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Method 2: Add Nodes First}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:method-2-add-nodes-first}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
For more control over node attributes and to ensure edges only connect existing nodes:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add nodes explicitly (as node\PYGZhy{}layer tuples)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Carol}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{colleagues}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{colleagues}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Dave}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{colleagues}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add edges between existing nodes}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Carol}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Method 3: Use Dictionary Format}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:method-3-use-dictionary-format}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
For networks with edge attributes and mixed field names (timestamps, types, etc.):

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add edges with custom attributes}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{weight}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{timestamp}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{2024\PYGZhy{}01\PYGZhy{}15}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{interaction\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{message}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Carol}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{weight}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mf}{2.5}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{timestamp}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{2024\PYGZhy{}01\PYGZhy{}16}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{dict}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Loading Networks from Files}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:loading-networks-from-files}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use file\sphinxhyphen{}based loading when your data already lives on disk. Edge lists remain the most compact choice; JSON is convenient for richer metadata. Each snippet builds the same \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{network}} interface shown above.


\paragraph{Load Edge Lists}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:load-edge-lists}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Most common format: one edge per line. The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{multiedgelist}} loader expects
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{source source\_layer target target\_layer weight}} (weight defaults to \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{1.0}} if omitted).

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{File format (stored as datasets/simple\_multiplex.txt in the repository):}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
Alice friends Bob friends 1.0
Bob friends Carol friends 1.0
Alice colleagues Bob colleagues 1.0
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Load it:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Option 1: Load from repository file}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{datasets/simple\PYGZus{}multiplex.txt}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{multiedgelist}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Option 2: Create from data directly (recommended for examples)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Carol}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{colleagues}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{colleagues}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{list}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{basic\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Load from Pandas DataFrame}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:load-from-pandas-dataframe}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Convert tabular data to networks (each row becomes an edge). Use separate \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{layer}} columns if endpoints belong to different layers.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{pandas} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n+nn}{pd}
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Your data}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{work}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Carol}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Carol}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{weight}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{2.0}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert to network}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{\PYGZus{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{row} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{iterrows}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edge}\PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{row}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{row}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{row}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{row}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{weight}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{row}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{weight}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
    \PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} If your dataframe has ``source\PYGZus{}layer`` and ``target\PYGZus{}layer`` columns,}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} pass those instead of a single ``layer`` column:}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} network.add\PYGZus{}edge(}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}     row[\PYGZsq{}source\PYGZsq{}], row[\PYGZsq{}source\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZsq{}],}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}     row[\PYGZsq{}target\PYGZsq{}], row[\PYGZsq{}target\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZsq{}],}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}     weight=row[\PYGZsq{}weight\PYGZsq{}]}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} )}

\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{basic\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Load from JSON}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:load-from-json}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
For complex networks with metadata (define both nodes and edges explicitly). Keep
edge dictionaries consistent: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{source}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{source\_layer}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{target}},
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{target\_layer}}, plus any other attributes you want to preserve.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{json}
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Load JSON}
\PYG{k}{with} \PYG{n+nb}{open}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network.json}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{r}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n}{f}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{data} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{json}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{f}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Assuming JSON structure: \PYGZob{}\PYGZdq{}edges\PYGZdq{}: [...], \PYGZdq{}nodes\PYGZdq{}: [...]\PYGZcb{}}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{edge} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{edges}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edge}\PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{o}{*}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{attributes}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Optionally, add nodes first if your JSON includes node attributes}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} for node in data.get(\PYGZsq{}nodes\PYGZsq{}, []):}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}     network.add\PYGZus{}nodes([(node[\PYGZsq{}id\PYGZsq{}], node[\PYGZsq{}layer\PYGZsq{}])])}

\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{basic\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Load from NetworkX}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:load-from-networkx}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Convert existing single\sphinxhyphen{}layer networks by assigning a default layer name. If the
original graph has edge attributes, pass them through \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{add\_edge}} as keyword
arguments.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{networkx} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n+nn}{nx}
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Existing NetworkX graph}
\PYG{n}{G} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{nx}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{karate\PYGZus{}club\PYGZus{}graph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert to multilayer (single layer)}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{u}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{v} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{G}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{u}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{v}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Loading with Inter\sphinxhyphen{}layer Edges}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:loading-with-inter-layer-edges}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
To represent the same entity across layers, connect node\sphinxhyphen{}layer tuples that share the same node identifier:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Intra\PYGZhy{}layer edges}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{work}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Carol}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{work}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{list}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Inter\PYGZhy{}layer edges (same person across layers)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{work}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{interlayer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{work}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{interlayer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Common Patterns}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:common-patterns}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Pick a template that matches your data model, then extend it with attributes as needed.


\paragraph{Pattern 1: Social Networks}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:pattern-1-social-networks}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Multiple relationship types between same people:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}

    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{linkedin}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{linkedin}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{twitter}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Carol}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{twitter}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{list}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Pattern 2: Heterogeneous Networks}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:pattern-2-heterogeneous-networks}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Different entity types:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Author\PYGZhy{}Paper bipartite network}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{authors}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Paper1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{papers}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}

\subsubsection{Verifying Your Network}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks:verifying-your-network}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
After loading, verify the structure to catch layer/weight mistakes early:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Basic stats}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{basic\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get specific information}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Layers: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{num\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{list}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Total nodes: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{num\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Check a specific layer}
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}
\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Friends layer: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ nodes}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\subsubsection{Overview}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:overview}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The Query Zoo is organized around common multilayer analysis tasks:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Basic Multilayer Exploration} — Understand layer statistics and structure

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Cross\sphinxhyphen{}Layer Hubs} — Find nodes that are important across multiple layers

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layer Similarity} — Measure structural alignment between layers

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Community Structure} — Detect and analyze multilayer communities

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Multiplex PageRank} — Compute multilayer\sphinxhyphen{}aware centrality

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Robustness Analysis} — Assess network resilience to layer failures

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Advanced Centrality Comparison} — Identify versatile vs specialized hubs

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Edge Grouping and Coverage} — Analyze edges across layer pairs with top\sphinxhyphen{}k and coverage

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxAtStartPar
All examples use small, reproducible multilayer networks from the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{examples/dsl\_query\_zoo/datasets.py}} module with fixed seeds so you can match the outputs shown here.

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{tip}{Tip:}
\sphinxAtStartPar

\subsubsection{1. Basic Multilayer Exploration}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:basic-multilayer-exploration}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Problem:} You’ve loaded a multilayer network and want to quickly understand its structure. Which layers are densest? How many nodes and edges does each layer have?

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solution:} Compute basic statistics per layer using the DSL.


\paragraph{Query Code}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:query-code}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k}{def} \PYG{n+nf}{query\PYGZus{}basic\PYGZus{}exploration}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{Network}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{l+s+sd}{\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}Summarize layers: node counts, edge counts, and average degree per layer.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Refactored: single DSL query over all layers + pandas groupby, no explicit}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    for\PYGZhy{}loop over layers.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    This query demonstrates basic multilayer exploration by computing}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    fundamental statistics for each layer independently. This is typically}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    the first step in multilayer analysis to understand the structure}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    and identify layers with different connectivity patterns.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Why it\PYGZsq{}s interesting:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Reveals which layers are denser or sparser}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Identifies layers that might be hubs of activity}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Shows structural diversity across the multilayer network}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    DSL concepts demonstrated:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} SELECT nodes from all layers in one shot}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Computing degree per layer}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Vectorized aggregation by layer}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Args:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        network: A multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network instance}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Returns:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        pd.DataFrame with columns: layer, n\PYGZus{}nodes, n\PYGZus{}edges, avg\PYGZus{}degree}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}       \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} all layers in one shot}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{==} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{:}
        \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{columns}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{n\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{n\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{avg\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} One row per (node, layer), so size() is node count}
    \PYG{n}{stats} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{groupby}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
          \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{agg}\PYG{p}{(}
              \PYG{n}{n\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{id}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{size}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
              \PYG{n}{total\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{sum}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
              \PYG{n}{avg\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{mean}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
          \PYG{p}{)}
          \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{reset\PYGZus{}index}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n}{stats}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{n\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{stats}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{total\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{/}\PYG{o}{/} \PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{astype}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{int}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{stats}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{avg\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{stats}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{avg\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{round}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{stats}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{n\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{n\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{avg\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Why It’s Interesting}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:why-it-s-interesting}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{First step in any analysis} — Before diving into complex queries, understand your data

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Reveals layer diversity} — Different layers often have vastly different structures

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Identifies sparse vs dense layers} — Helps decide which layers need special handling

\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{2. Cross\sphinxhyphen{}Layer Hubs}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:cross-layer-hubs}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Problem:} Which nodes are consistently important across \sphinxstyleemphasis{multiple} layers? These “super hubs” are critical because they bridge different contexts.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solution:} Find top\sphinxhyphen{}k central nodes per layer, then identify which nodes appear in multiple layers’ top lists.


\paragraph{Query Code}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id1}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k}{def} \PYG{n+nf}{query\PYGZus{}cross\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}hubs}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{Network}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{k}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n+nb}{int} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{l+s+sd}{\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}Find nodes that are consistently central across multiple layers.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Refactored: one DSL query across all layers + pandas grouping, no explicit}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    per\PYGZhy{}layer for loop.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    This query identifies \PYGZdq{}super hubs\PYGZdq{} \PYGZhy{} nodes that maintain high centrality}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    across different layers. These nodes are particularly important because}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    they serve as connectors across different contexts or domains.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Why it\PYGZsq{}s interesting:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Reveals nodes with consistent importance across contexts}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Useful for identifying key actors in multiplex social networks}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Helps understand cross\PYGZhy{}layer influence and information flow}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    DSL concepts demonstrated:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Single query across all layers}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Computing betweenness centrality}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Vectorized top\PYGZhy{}k selection per layer using groupby}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Coverage analysis (nodes appearing in multiple layers)}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Args:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        network: A multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network instance}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        k: Number of top nodes to select per layer}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Returns:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        pd.DataFrame with nodes and their centrality scores per layer}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{==} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{:}
        \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{rename}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{columns}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{id}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{node}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Top\PYGZhy{}k by betweenness within each layer (vectorized)}
    \PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}sorted} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{sort\PYGZus{}values}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
                               \PYG{n}{ascending}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{topk} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}sorted}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{groupby}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{head}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{k}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Count how many layers each node appears in as a top\PYGZhy{}k hub}
    \PYG{n}{coverage} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{topk}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{groupby}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{node}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
            \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nunique}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
            \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{reset\PYGZus{}index}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{name}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer\PYGZus{}count}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n}{result\PYGZus{}df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{topk}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{merge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{coverage}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{on}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{node}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
            \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{sort\PYGZus{}values}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer\PYGZus{}count}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
                         \PYG{n}{ascending}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{result\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{node}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
                      \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer\PYGZus{}count}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Why It’s Interesting}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id2}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Reveals cross\sphinxhyphen{}context influence} — Nodes central in one layer might be peripheral in another

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Identifies key connectors} — Nodes that appear in multiple layers’ top\sphinxhyphen{}k are especially important

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Robust hub detection} — More reliable than single\sphinxhyphen{}layer centrality

\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{3. Layer Similarity}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:layer-similarity}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Problem:} How similar are different layers structurally? Do they serve redundant or complementary roles?

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solution:} Compute degree distributions per layer and measure pairwise correlations.


\paragraph{Query Code}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id5}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k}{def} \PYG{n+nf}{query\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}similarity}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{Network}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{l+s+sd}{\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}Compute structural similarity between layers based on degree distributions.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Refactored: single DSL query + pivot, no explicit loops over layers/nodes.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    This query measures how similar different layers are in terms of their}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    connectivity patterns. Layers with similar degree distributions likely}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    serve similar structural roles in the multilayer network.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Why it\PYGZsq{}s interesting:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Identifies redundant or complementary layers}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Helps understand layer specialization}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Can inform layer aggregation or simplification decisions}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    DSL concepts demonstrated:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Single query across all layers}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Pivot table to create node × layer matrix}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Correlation between layers via .corr()}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Args:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        network: A multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network instance}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Returns:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        pd.DataFrame: Pairwise correlation matrix of layer degree distributions}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{==} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{:}
        \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Build node × layer degree matrix: rows = nodes, cols = layers}
    \PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}matrix} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{pivot\PYGZus{}table}\PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{index}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{id}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{columns}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{values}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{fill\PYGZus{}value}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Correlation between columns = correlation between layers}
    \PYG{n}{corr\PYGZus{}df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}matrix}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{corr}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{round}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Optional: clean up index/column names for display}
    \PYG{n}{corr\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{index}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{name} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{k+kc}{None}
    \PYG{n}{corr\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{columns}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{name} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{k+kc}{None}

    \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{corr\PYGZus{}df}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Why It’s Interesting}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id6}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Detects redundancy} — High correlation suggests layers capture similar structure

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Guides simplification} — Nearly identical layers might be merged

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Reveals specialization} — Low/negative correlation shows layers serve different roles

\end{itemize}

\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id8}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Layer\sphinxhyphen{}by\sphinxhyphen{}layer degree computation

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Aggregating results across layers for meta\sphinxhyphen{}analysis

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Using computed attributes for layer\sphinxhyphen{}level comparisons

\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{4. Community Structure}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:community-structure}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Problem:} What communities exist in the multilayer network? How do they manifest across layers?

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solution:} Detect communities using multilayer community detection, then analyze their distribution across layers.


\paragraph{Query Code}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id9}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k}{def} \PYG{n+nf}{query\PYGZus{}community\PYGZus{}structure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{Network}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{l+s+sd}{\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}Detect communities and analyze their distribution across layers.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    This query finds communities in the multilayer network and examines}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    how they manifest across different layers. Some communities might be}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    tightly connected in one layer but dispersed in others.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Why it\PYGZsq{}s interesting:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Reveals mesoscale structure in multilayer networks}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Shows how communities span or specialize across layers}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Useful for understanding multi\PYGZhy{}context group formation}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    DSL concepts demonstrated:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Community detection via DSL}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Grouping by community and layer}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Aggregation and counting}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Args:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        network: A multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network instance}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Returns:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        pd.DataFrame with community info: community\PYGZus{}id, layer, size, dominant\PYGZus{}layer}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}}
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compute communities across all layers}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} All layers}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{communities}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{==} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{:}
        \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Rename \PYGZsq{}id\PYGZsq{} column to \PYGZsq{}node\PYGZsq{} for clarity}
    \PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{rename}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{columns}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{node}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Analyze community distribution across layers}
    \PYG{n}{community\PYGZus{}stats} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{groupby}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{communities}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{agg}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{node}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{count}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{reset\PYGZus{}index}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{n}{community\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{columns} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{community\PYGZus{}id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{size}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{avg\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
    
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Find dominant layer for each community (layer with most nodes)}
    \PYG{n}{dominant} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{community\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{loc}\PYG{p}{[}
        \PYG{n}{community\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{groupby}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{community\PYGZus{}id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{size}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{idxmax}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{community\PYGZus{}id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{rename}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{columns}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{dominant\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Merge dominant layer info}
    \PYG{n}{result\PYGZus{}df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{community\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{merge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{dominant}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{on}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{community\PYGZus{}id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Sort by community size}
    \PYG{n}{result\PYGZus{}df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{sort\PYGZus{}values}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{community\PYGZus{}id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{size}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{ascending}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{result\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{community\PYGZus{}id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{size}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{avg\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{dominant\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\subsubsection{5. Multiplex PageRank}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:multiplex-pagerank}}

\sphinxstylestrong{Problem:} Standard PageRank treats each layer independently. How do we compute importance considering the full multiplex structure?

\sphinxstylestrong{Solution:} Compute PageRank per layer, then take the average across layers as a simplified multiplex score. (True multiplex PageRank uses supra\sphinxhyphen{}adjacency matrices.)

         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{pagerank}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{6. Robustness Analysis}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Problem:} How robust is the network to layer failures? What happens if one layer goes offline?

\sphinxstylestrong{Solution:} Simulate removing each layer and measure connectivity loss.


\paragraph{Query Code}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{l+s+sd}{\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}Evaluate network robustness by removing each layer and recomputing stats.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    This query demonstrates robustness analysis by simulating layer failure.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    For each layer, we measure how connectivity changes if that layer is removed.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    This reveals which layers are critical for network cohesion.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Note: The loop over layers is semantically part of the experiment design}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    (each iteration is a different scenario), which is an acceptable use of loops.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Why it\PYGZsq{}s interesting:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Identifies critical infrastructure layers}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Measures redundancy in multilayer systems}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Informs resilience strategies and backup planning}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Essential for analyzing cascading failures}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    DSL concepts demonstrated:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Layer selection and filtering}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Computing connectivity metrics}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Comparing network states (with/without layers)}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Using functools.reduce for cleaner layer expressions}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Args:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        network: A multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network instance}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Returns:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        pd.DataFrame comparing connectivity with each layer removed}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}}
    \PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{functools} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{reduce}
    \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{operator}
    
    \PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{\PYGZus{}get\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}names}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Baseline: connectivity with all layers}
    \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}avg\PYGZus{}degree} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}total\PYGZus{}degree} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{sum}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{n}{results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{scenario}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{baseline (all layers)}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{n\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{avg\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n+nb}{round}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}avg\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{total\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{baseline\PYGZus{}total\PYGZus{}degree} \PYG{o}{/}\PYG{o}{/} \PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{connectivity\PYGZus{}loss}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{]}
    
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Test removing each layer (scenario loop \PYGZhy{} part of experiment design)}
    \PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}to\PYGZus{}remove} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{p}{:}

        \PYG{n}{remaining\PYGZus{}exprs} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{layer} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{layer} \PYG{o}{!=} \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}to\PYGZus{}remove}\PYG{p}{]}
        
        \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{o+ow}{not} \PYG{n}{remaining\PYGZus{}exprs}\PYG{p}{:}

        \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Query with reduced layer set}

            \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
             \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{remaining\PYGZus{}expr}\PYG{p}{)}
             \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
             \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{p}{)}
        
        \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{reduced\PYGZus{}result}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{:}
            \PYG{n}{reduced\PYGZus{}df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{reduced\PYGZus{}result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\sphinxstylestrong{Interpretation:} Removing the bus layer causes 46.67\% connectivity loss — it’s the most critical layer. Walking is least critical (only 6.67\% loss), indicating good redundancy from other transport modes. Connectivity loss is computed from total degree (divided by 2 for undirected edges), so it assumes undirected layers.
The reported loss compares baseline total degree to the degree after removing a layer; for undirected networks total degree is twice the number of edges.

\subsubsection{7. Advanced Centrality Comparison}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:advanced-centrality-comparison}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Problem:} Different centralities capture different notions of importance. Which nodes are “versatile hubs” (high in many centralities relative to the best scorer) vs “specialized hubs” (high in only one)?

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solution:} Compute multiple centralities, normalize them, and classify nodes by how many centralities place them in the top tier.

\paragraph{Why It’s Interesting}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id22}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Centrality is multifaceted} — Degree ≠ betweenness ≠ closeness ≠ PageRank

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Versatile hubs are robust} — High across many metrics means genuine importance

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Specialized hubs reveal roles} — High in one metric reveals specific structural position

\end{itemize}

\subsubsection{8. Edge Grouping and Coverage}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:edge-grouping-and-coverage}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Problem:} You want to analyze which edges (connections) are important within and between layers. Which edges consistently appear in the top\sphinxhyphen{}k across different layer\sphinxhyphen{}pair contexts?

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solution:} Use the new \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.per\_layer\_pair()}} method to group edges by (src\_layer, dst\_layer) pairs, then keep the top\sphinxhyphen{}k edges per pair. (Add \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.coverage(...)}} if you later need to filter across groups.)


\paragraph{Query Code}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id25}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k}{def} \PYG{n+nf}{query\PYGZus{}edge\PYGZus{}grouping\PYGZus{}and\PYGZus{}coverage}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{Network}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{k}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n+nb}{int} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{n}{Dict}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n+nb}{str}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{l+s+sd}{\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}Analyze edges across layer pairs with grouping and coverage.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    This query demonstrates the powerful new edge grouping capabilities}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    introduced in DSL v2. It groups edges by (src\PYGZus{}layer, dst\PYGZus{}layer) pairs}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    and analyzes edge distribution across layer pairs.}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Why it\PYGZsq{}s interesting:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Reveals how connections are distributed within and between layers}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Shows which layer pairs have more connectivity}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Identifies edges that appear across multiple layer contexts}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Essential for understanding cross\PYGZhy{}layer edge patterns}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    DSL concepts demonstrated:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} .per\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}pair() for edge grouping}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} .coverage() for cross\PYGZhy{}group filtering}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} Edge\PYGZhy{}specific grouping metadata}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZhy{} .group\PYGZus{}summary() for aggregate statistics}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Args:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        network: A multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network instance}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        k: Number of edges to limit per layer pair (default: 3)}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        }
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    Returns:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        Dictionary with:}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        \PYGZhy{} \PYGZsq{}edges\PYGZus{}by\PYGZus{}pair\PYGZsq{}: DataFrame with edges grouped by layer pair}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{        \PYGZhy{} \PYGZsq{}summary\PYGZsq{}: DataFrame with edge counts per layer pair}
\PYG{l+s+sd}{    \PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}}
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Query: Get edges grouped by layer pair}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}pair}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
            \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{k}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Limit to k edges per pair}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{==} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{:}
        \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
            \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{edges\PYGZus{}by\PYGZus{}pair}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
            \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{summary}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
    
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get edges DataFrame}
    \PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}edges} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get group summary}
    \PYG{n}{summary} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{group\PYGZus{}summary}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    
    \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{edges\PYGZus{}by\PYGZus{}pair}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{summary}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{summary}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Why It’s Interesting}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id26}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layer\sphinxhyphen{}pair\sphinxhyphen{}aware analysis} — Different layer pairs may have very different edge patterns

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Universal edges} — Edges important across multiple contexts are more robust

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Cross\sphinxhyphen{}layer dynamics} — Reveals how connections vary between intra\sphinxhyphen{}layer and inter\sphinxhyphen{}layer contexts

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Edge\sphinxhyphen{}centric view} — Complements node\sphinxhyphen{}centric analyses like hub detection

\end{itemize}

\sphinxstylestrong{Interpretation:} The query reveals edge distribution across layer pairs. Each intra\sphinxhyphen{}layer pair (e.g., social\sphinxhyphen{}social, work\sphinxhyphen{}work) contains up to k=3 edges. The sample dataset has only intra\sphinxhyphen{}layer edges; inter\sphinxhyphen{}layer pairs would appear if your network contains cross\sphinxhyphen{}layer connections. The family layer has sparser connectivity overall, so only three family edges remain after limiting.
When no sort key is provided, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{top\_k}} keeps edges by their existing order; specify a weight to make the selection explicitly score\sphinxhyphen{}based.


\paragraph{DSL Concepts Demonstrated}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:id28}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.per\_layer\_pair()}} — Group edges by (src\_layer, dst\_layer) pairs

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.top\_k(k, "weight")}} — Select top\sphinxhyphen{}k items per group

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.coverage(mode="at\_least", k=2)}} — Optional cross\sphinxhyphen{}group filtering

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.group\_summary()}} — Get aggregate statistics per group

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Edge\sphinxhyphen{}specific grouping metadata in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{QueryResult.meta{[}"grouping"{]}}}

\end{itemize}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{tip}{Tip:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{New in DSL v2}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Edge grouping and coverage are new features that parallel the existing node
grouping capabilities. Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.per\_layer\_pair()}} for edges and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.per\_layer()}}
for nodes. Both support the same coverage modes and grouping operations.
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\subsubsection{Using the Query Zoo}

\paragraph{Getting Started}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:getting-started}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Install py3plex} (if not already installed):

\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{examples}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl\PYGZus{}query\PYGZus{}zoo}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{datasets} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{create\PYGZus{}social\PYGZus{}work\PYGZus{}network}
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{examples}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl\PYGZus{}query\PYGZus{}zoo}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{queries} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{query\PYGZus{}basic\PYGZus{}exploration}

\PYG{n}{net} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{create\PYGZus{}social\PYGZus{}work\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{seed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{42}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{query\PYGZus{}basic\PYGZus{}exploration}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{net}\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Adapting Queries to Your Data}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:adapting-queries-to-your-data}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
All queries are designed to work with any \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{multi\_layer\_network}} object. To adapt:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Replace the dataset}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Load your own network}
\PYG{n}{my\PYGZus{}network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{my\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{mydata.edgelist}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{edgelist\PYGZus{}mx}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Run any query}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{query\PYGZus{}cross\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}hubs}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{my\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{k}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Adjust parameters}:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{k}} in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{query\_cross\_layer\_hubs}} — Number of top nodes per layer

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Layer names in filters — Replace \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L{[}"social"{]}}} with your layer names

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Centrality thresholds — Adjust percentile cutoffs as needed

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Extend queries}:

\sphinxAtStartPar
All query functions are in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{examples/dsl\_query\_zoo/queries.py}}. Copy, modify, and experiment!

\end{enumerate}


\paragraph{Datasets}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_zoo:datasets}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Three multilayer networks are provided:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{social\_work\_network}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layers:} social, work, family

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Nodes:} 12 people

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Structure:} Overlapping social circles with different connectivity patterns per layer

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{communication\_network}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layers:} email, chat, phone

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Nodes:} 10 people (Manager, Dev team, Marketing, Support, HR)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Structure:} Star topology in email, distributed in chat/phone

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{transport\_network}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layers:} bus, metro, walking

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Nodes:} 8 locations (CentralStation, ShoppingMall, Park, etc.)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Structure:} Bus covers most locations, metro is faster but selective, walking is local

\end{itemize}

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxAtStartPar
All datasets use fixed random seeds (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{seed=42}}) for reproducibility.

\subsection{How to Compute Network Statistics}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/compute_statistics:how-to-compute-network-statistics}}\label{\detokenize{how-to/compute_statistics::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Goal:} Calculate metrics that describe the structure of your multilayer network—quick counts, per\sphinxhyphen{}layer comparisons, node\sphinxhyphen{}level rankings, and multilayer\sphinxhyphen{}specific measures.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Prerequisites:} A loaded network (see {\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Load and Build Networks}}}}). Examples reuse the same small network unless noted.

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Imports used below

\sphinxAtStartPar
Most snippets rely on the DSL helpers \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Q}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L}}:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Where to find this data

\sphinxAtStartPar
Examples in this guide use:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Programmatically created networks} (recommended for self\sphinxhyphen{}contained examples)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Built\sphinxhyphen{}in generators}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{from py3plex.algorithms import random\_generators}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Example files}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{datasets/multiedgelist.txt}} in the repository

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
For reproducibility, we’ll create networks from scratch in most examples.
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{A}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{B}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{B}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{C}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{1}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{A}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{2}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{C}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{2}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{C}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{2}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{D}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{2}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{list}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
