\paragraph{Filter by Property}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:filter-by-property}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use comparisons to filter nodes by computed or intrinsic attributes:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} High\PYGZhy{}degree nodes}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{execute\PYGZus{}query}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{SELECT nodes WHERE degree \PYGZgt{} 5}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{High\PYGZhy{}degree nodes: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Multilayer nodes with high degree}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{execute\PYGZus{}query}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{SELECT nodes WHERE degree \PYGZgt{} 5 AND layer\PYGZus{}count \PYGZgt{}= 2}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{High\PYGZhy{}degree multilayer nodes: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Supported operators:} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textgreater{}}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textgreater{}=}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textless{}}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textless{}=}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{=}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{!=}}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Multiple conditions} are combined with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{AND}}. For more complex logic, use the builder API (see below).

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output (counts will vary with your data):}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
High\PYGZhy{}degree nodes: 34
High\PYGZhy{}degree multilayer nodes: 18
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Compute Statistics}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:compute-statistics}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{COMPUTE}} clause calculates network metrics and attaches them to result rows. This is where the DSL becomes powerful for analysis:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compute degree and betweenness centrality for nodes in \PYGZsq{}social\PYGZsq{} layer}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{execute\PYGZus{}query}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{SELECT nodes WHERE layer=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{COMPUTE degree COMPUTE betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert to pandas for analysis}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Top nodes by betweenness centrality:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{head}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Summary statistics:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{describe}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output (values depend on the network):}

\subsubsection{Builder API (Type\sphinxhyphen{}Safe)}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:builder-api-type-safe}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxstylestrong{builder API is the recommended approach for production code}. It provides:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
IDE autocompletion and inline documentation

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Type checking with tools like mypy

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Clearer error messages

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Easier refactoring and composition of queries

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
All builder queries compile to the same AST as string queries, ensuring consistent semantics.


\paragraph{Basic Queries}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:basic-queries}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Create and execute queries using the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Q}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L}} imports:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get all nodes}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Total nodes: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get nodes from a specific layer}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Nodes in }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ layer: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Query reusability:} You can define a query once and execute it with different networks:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{high\PYGZus{}degree\PYGZus{}query} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Execute on multiple networks}
\PYG{n}{result\PYGZus{}network1} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{high\PYGZus{}degree\PYGZus{}query}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network1}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{result\PYGZus{}network2} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{high\PYGZus{}degree\PYGZus{}query}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network2}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Filtering}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:filtering}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{where()}} to add filter conditions. The builder API uses Django\sphinxhyphen{}style \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_}} suffixes for comparisons:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Filter by property}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Nodes with degree \PYGZgt{} 5: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Multiple conditions (combined with AND)}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}count\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gte}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Multilayer high\PYGZhy{}degree nodes in }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Supported comparison suffixes:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_gt}}: greater than (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textgreater{}}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_gte}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_ge}}: greater than or equal (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textgreater{}=}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_lt}}: less than (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textless{}}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_lte}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_le}}: less than or equal (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textless{}=}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_eq}}: equal (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{=}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_ne}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\_\_neq}}: not equal (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{!=}})

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Understanding} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{layer\_count}}:

\sphinxAtStartPar
In multilayer networks, a node may appear in multiple layers. The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{layer\_count}} attribute indicates how many layers the node participates in:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{layer\_count\_\_gte=2}}: nodes appearing in at least 2 layers

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{layer\_count\_\_eq=1}}: nodes appearing in exactly 1 layer (layer\sphinxhyphen{}specific nodes)

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
This is useful for identifying “connector” nodes that bridge multiple contexts.


\paragraph{Computing Metrics}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:computing-metrics}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{compute()}} to calculate network metrics. Metrics are computed efficiently and attached to result rows:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compute multiple metrics}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Convert to DataFrame and analyze}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{head}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get top nodes by a metric}
\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}by\PYGZus{}betweenness} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nlargest}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Top 10 nodes by betweenness centrality:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}by\PYGZus{}betweenness}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Order of operations:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{compute()}} can be called at any point in the chain

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Filters (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{where()}}) can reference computed metrics only if the metric is computed \sphinxstylestrong{before} the filter

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For best performance, filter first, then compute:

\end{itemize}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Good: Filter first, then compute}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output (illustrative):}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

...

\paragraph{Computing Metrics with Uncertainty}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:computing-metrics-with-uncertainty}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{New in py3plex 1.0:} The DSL now supports \sphinxstylestrong{first\sphinxhyphen{}class uncertainty} for computed metrics. This allows you to estimate statistical uncertainty (confidence intervals, standard deviations) for network statistics via bootstrap, perturbation, or Monte Carlo methods.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Why uncertainty matters:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Networks are often noisy or sampled (e.g., social networks with missing edges)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Centrality metrics can be sensitive to small perturbations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Uncertainty quantification helps distinguish signal from noise

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Required for robust statistical inference and hypothesis testing

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Basic usage:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compute degree with uncertainty estimation}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}
         \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{n}{uncertainty}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{n}{method}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{perturbation}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} or \PYGZdq{}bootstrap\PYGZdq{}, \PYGZdq{}seed\PYGZdq{}}
         \PYG{n}{n\PYGZus{}samples}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{100}\PYG{p}{,}          \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} number of resamples}
         \PYG{n}{ci}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.95}                 \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} confidence interval level}
     \PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Access uncertainty information}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{head}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Results contain mean, std, and quantiles for each metric}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} The \PYGZsq{}degree\PYGZsq{} column now has dict values with uncertainty info}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Uncertainty methods:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"perturbation"}}: Drop a small fraction of edges/nodes randomly (default: 5\%)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"bootstrap"}}: Resample nodes/edges with replacement

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"seed"}}: Run stochastic algorithms with different random seeds

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"jackknife"}}: Leave\sphinxhyphen{}one\sphinxhyphen{}out resampling

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Parameters:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{uncertainty}} (bool): Enable uncertainty estimation (default: False)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{method}} (str): Resampling strategy (default: “perturbation”)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{n\_samples}} (int): Number of resamples (default: 50)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ci}} (float): Confidence interval level, e.g., 0.95 for 95\% CI (default: 0.95)

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Example with confidence intervals:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Find hubs with uncertainty bounds}
\PYG{n}{hubs} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}
         \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{n}{uncertainty}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{n}{method}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{perturbation}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{n}{n\PYGZus{}samples}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{200}\PYG{p}{,}
         \PYG{n}{ci}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.95}
     \PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Extract uncertainty information}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{hubs}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} When uncertainty=True, values are dicts with mean, std, quantiles}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{idx}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{row} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{head}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{iterrows}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{node\PYGZus{}id} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{row}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
    \PYG{n}{bc\PYGZus{}info} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{row}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}

    \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n+nb}{isinstance}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{bc\PYGZus{}info}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n+nb}{dict}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
        \PYG{n}{mean} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{bc\PYGZus{}info}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
        \PYG{n}{std} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{bc\PYGZus{}info}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{std}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{n}{ci\PYGZus{}low} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{bc\PYGZus{}info}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{quantiles}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.025}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{n}{ci\PYGZus{}high} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{bc\PYGZus{}info}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{quantiles}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.975}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{)}

\sphinxstylestrong{Use cases:}
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Comparing networks}: Test if centrality differences between networks are statistically significant

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Robust ranking}: Identify nodes that consistently rank high across perturbations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Network inference}: Quantify uncertainty when inferring networks from noisy data

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Hypothesis testing}: Generate null distributions for significance testing

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Performance notes:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Uncertainty estimation is \sphinxstylestrong{opt\sphinxhyphen{}in} and only runs when explicitly requested

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cost scales linearly with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{n\_samples}} (e.g., 100 samples ≈ 100× slower)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use smaller \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{n\_samples}} (20\sphinxhyphen{}50) for exploration, larger (100\sphinxhyphen{}500) for publication

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Perturbation is fastest; bootstrap and jackknife are more expensive

\end{itemize}

\paragraph{Sorting and Limiting}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:sorting-and-limiting}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{order\_by()}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{limit()}} to control result ordering and size:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get top 10 nodes by degree}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} \PYGZdq{}\PYGZhy{}\PYGZdq{} prefix for descending}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Top 10 highest\PYGZhy{}degree nodes:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{data} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{items}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{  }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: degree=}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\subsubsection{Working with Results}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:working-with-results}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
DSL queries return a \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{QueryResult}} object that provides multiple ways to access and export data. Understanding how to work with results is crucial for integrating DSL queries into analysis pipelines.


\paragraph{Access as Dictionary}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:access-as-dictionary}}

\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{QueryResult}} provides dictionary\sphinxhyphen{}like access via \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.items()}}:

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Iterate over all items}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{data} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{items}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: degree=}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Inspect one sample entry}
\PYG{n}{sample\PYGZus{}key}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{sample\PYGZus{}value} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{next}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{iter}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{items}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Sample key type: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{type}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{sample\PYGZus{}key}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Sample key: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{sample\PYGZus{}key}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Sample value: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{sample\PYGZus{}value}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{node}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{tolist}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{index}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{index}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{drop}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{axis}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{set\PYGZus{}index}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{node}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{head}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Filter Results}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:filter-results}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
You can filter results in two ways: \sphinxstylestrong{using the DSL’s} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{where()}} \sphinxstylestrong{clause} (recommended) or \sphinxstylestrong{post\sphinxhyphen{}processing} with Python/pandas.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Option 1: Filter in the query (recommended for large networks):}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Filter before computation for efficiency}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Option 2: Filter the result dictionary (for small networks or ad\sphinxhyphen{}hoc filtering):}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Pure Python filtering}
\PYG{n}{high\PYGZus{}degree} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
    \PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{data}
    \PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{data} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{items}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{5}
\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{High\PYGZhy{}degree nodes: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{high\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Option 3: Filter the DataFrame (most flexible for complex conditions):}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Use pandas boolean indexing}
\PYG{n}{filtered} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{]}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Complex conditions}
\PYG{n}{interesting\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZam{}}
    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{]}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Performance note:} For very large networks (millions of nodes), filtering in the DSL query (Option 1) is most efficient because it avoids materializing unnecessary results. For smaller networks, pandas filtering (Option 3) is often more convenient.


\subsubsection{Advanced Queries}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:advanced-queries}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This section showcases the DSL’s power for sophisticated multilayer network analysis. These patterns are common in research and can be adapted to your specific needs.


\paragraph{Multiple Layer Selection}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:multiple-layer-selection}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxstylestrong{layer algebra} to combine layers. The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L}} object supports set operations (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{|}} for union, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\&}} for intersection, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\sphinxhyphen{}}} for difference):

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Union: nodes/edges from EITHER layer}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{|} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Combined nodes from }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ and }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Average degree across both layers: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Set semantics:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L{[}"friends"{]} | L{[}"work"{]}}}: \sphinxstylestrong{Union} of nodes/edges from both layers (nodes appearing in either layer)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L{[}"friends"{]} \& L{[}"work"{]}}}: \sphinxstylestrong{Intersection} (see next section)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L{[}"friends"{]} \sphinxhyphen{} L{[}"work"{]}}}: \sphinxstylestrong{Difference} (nodes in friends but not work)

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use case:} Compare activity across related contexts. For example, analyze user behavior across social and professional networks together.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

Average degree across both layers: 6.12
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Layer Intersection}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:layer-intersection}}
\sphinxAtStartPar

    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{\PYGZam{}} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Nodes in both }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ and }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{These are }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{connector}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ nodes bridging social and professional contexts}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{head}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Semantics:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L{[}"friends"{]} \& L{[}"work"{]}}} selects nodes that have representations in \sphinxstylestrong{both} layers

\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{head}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Mean edge betweenness: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{edge\PYGZus{}betweenness}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.3f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Intralayer edges: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{intralayer\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Smart Defaults and Error Messages}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:smart-defaults-and-error-messages}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The DSL includes \sphinxstylestrong{smart defaults} that automatically compute commonly used centrality metrics when referenced but not explicitly computed. This feature makes queries more ergonomic while maintaining predictable behavior.


\paragraph{Auto\sphinxhyphen{}Computing Centrality Metrics}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:auto-computing-centrality-metrics}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
When you reference a centrality metric in operations like \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{top\_k()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{order\_by()}}, or other ranking operations, the DSL will automatically compute it if not already present:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} The DSL auto\PYGZhy{}computes betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality when needed}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}computed here}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality column is available even though}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} we didn\PYGZsq{}t explicitly call .compute(\PYGZdq{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality\PYGZdq{})}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Supported centrality aliases:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree\_centrality}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{betweenness}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{betweenness\_centrality}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{closeness}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{closeness\_centrality}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{eigenvector}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{eigenvector\_centrality}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pagerank}}

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{When auto\sphinxhyphen{}compute happens:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
When the attribute is referenced in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{top\_k()}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
When the attribute is used in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{order\_by()}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For both per\sphinxhyphen{}group (with grouping) and global operations

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Example with multiple auto\sphinxhyphen{}computed metrics:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}compute degree for filtering and betweenness for ranking}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} degree auto\PYGZhy{}computed here}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{desc}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} betweenness auto\PYGZhy{}computed here}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
    node layer  degree  betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality
0  alice social      8                0.143000
1    bob social      7                0.098000
2  carol social      6                0.067000
...
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Controlling Autocompute Behavior}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:controlling-autocompute-behavior}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
You can explicitly control whether metrics are automatically computed using the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{autocompute}} parameter:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Disable autocompute \PYGZhy{} require explicit .compute() calls}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{autocompute}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Autocompute disabled}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Must explicitly compute}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} This would raise DslMissingMetricError because betweenness is not computed:}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Q.nodes(autocompute=False).order\PYGZus{}by(\PYGZdq{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality\PYGZdq{}).execute(net)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{When to disable autocompute:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Performance\sphinxhyphen{}critical code}: Avoid unexpected expensive computations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Explicit control}: Make all metric computations visible in code

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Debugging}: Understand exactly which metrics are computed and when

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Tracking computed metrics:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Query results include a \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{computed\_metrics}} attribute that tracks which metrics were computed during execution:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}computed}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Check which metrics were computed}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Computed metrics: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{computed\PYGZus{}metrics}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Output: Computed metrics: \PYGZob{}\PYGZsq{}degree\PYGZsq{}, \PYGZsq{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality\PYGZsq{}\PYGZcb{}}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use cases for computed\_metrics:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Performance profiling: identify expensive operations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Query optimization: avoid redundant computations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Debugging: verify expected metrics were computed

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Helpful Error Messages with Suggestions}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:helpful-error-messages-with-suggestions}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
When you reference an unknown attribute, the DSL provides \sphinxstylestrong{did you mean?} suggestions using fuzzy string matching:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Typo in attribute name}
\PYG{k}{try}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
            \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Typo: \PYGZdq{}betweness\PYGZdq{} instead of \PYGZdq{}betweenness\PYGZdq{}}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{except} \PYG{n}{UnknownAttributeError} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n}{e}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{e}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Output:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
Unknown attribute \PYGZsq{}betweness\PYGZus{}centrality\PYGZsq{}. Did you mean \PYGZsq{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality\PYGZsq{}?
Known attributes: betweenness, betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality, closeness, closeness\PYGZus{}centrality,
                  degree, degree\PYGZus{}centrality, eigenvector, eigenvector\PYGZus{}centrality, pagerank
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\paragraph{Grouping Requirements and Clear Errors}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:grouping-requirements-and-clear-errors}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Some operations require \sphinxstylestrong{active grouping} (via \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{per\_layer()}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{group\_by()}}). The DSL raises \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{GroupingError}} with clear guidance when these operations are used incorrectly:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{errors} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{GroupingError}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} This will raise GroupingError}
\PYG{k}{try}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{coverage}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{mode}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{all}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Error: no grouping active}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{except} \PYG{n}{GroupingError} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n}{e}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{e}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Output:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

No grouping is currently active.

    Q.nodes().from\PYGZus{}layers(L[\PYGZdq{}*\PYGZdq{}])
        .per\PYGZus{}layer().top\PYGZus{}k(5, \PYGZdq{}degree\PYGZdq{}).end\PYGZus{}grouping()

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Correct usage:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add grouping here}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{When Smart Defaults DON’T Apply}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:when-smart-defaults-don-t-apply}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Smart defaults are \sphinxstylestrong{predictable and conservative}. They only apply in specific scenarios:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Only for centrality metrics}: Smart defaults work for recognized centrality metrics (degree, betweenness, etc.), not arbitrary attributes.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Explicit compute takes precedence}: If you explicitly compute a metric, the DSL uses your computation and doesn’t auto\sphinxhyphen{}compute:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Explicit compute \PYGZhy{} no auto\PYGZhy{}compute happens}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Explicit}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Uses explicit computation}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Edge attributes are not auto\sphinxhyphen{}computed}: For edge queries, attributes like \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{weight}} are read from edge data, not auto\sphinxhyphen{}computed:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edge weight is read from edge data, not computed}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Temporal Queries}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:temporal-queries}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The DSL supports temporal filtering for networks with time\sphinxhyphen{}stamped edges or nodes. Four convenience methods provide intuitive temporal filtering: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.at(t)}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.during(t0, t1)}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.before(t)}}, and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.after(t)}}.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Prerequisites for temporal queries:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Edges or nodes must have temporal attributes:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Point\sphinxhyphen{}in\sphinxhyphen{}time}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t}} attribute (e.g., \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\{"t": 150.0\}}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Intervals}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t\_start}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t\_end}} attributes (e.g., \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\{"t\_start": 100.0, "t\_end": 200.0\}}})

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Time values are typically numeric (timestamps) or ISO date strings

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Detailed semantics:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{at(t)}}: Selects entities active at a specific moment
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For point\sphinxhyphen{}in\sphinxhyphen{}time edges: includes edges where \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t\_edge == t}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For interval edges: includes edges where \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t}} is in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{{[}t\_start, t\_end{]}}}

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{during(t0, t1)}}: Selects entities active during a time window
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For point\sphinxhyphen{}in\sphinxhyphen{}time edges: includes edges where \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t}} is in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{{[}t0, t1{]}}} (closed interval)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For interval edges: includes edges where the interval \sphinxstylestrong{overlaps} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{{[}t0, t1{]}}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{None}} values: Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t0=None}} for open lower bound, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t1=None}} for open upper bound

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{before(t)}}: Selects entities active before (and at) time t
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Convenience method equivalent to \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.during(None, t)}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Inclusive of the boundary: includes entities at exactly time t

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{after(t)}}: Selects entities active after (and at) time t
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Convenience method equivalent to \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.during(t, None)}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Inclusive of the boundary: includes entities at exactly time t

\end{itemize}

\end{itemize}

\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:filter-by-time-snapshot}}

     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Nodes active at t=150: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Average degree at t=150: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Top nodes by degree at this snapshot:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nlargest}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Nodes at t=150 (snapshot): }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{snapshot\PYGZus{}result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Common pattern: compare network before and after an event}
\PYG{n}{event\PYGZus{}time} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{150.0}

\PYG{n}{before\PYGZus{}event} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{before}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{event\PYGZus{}time}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{after\PYGZus{}event} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{after}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{event\PYGZus{}time}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compare metrics}
\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}before} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{before\PYGZus{}event}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}after} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{after\PYGZus{}event}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Average degree before event: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}before}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Average degree after event: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}after}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Network became }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{denser}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{if}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}after}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}before}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{else}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{sparser}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output:}

\sphinxstylestrong{Temporal edges example:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edges active during a period}
\PYG{n}{edges} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{during}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{100.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{200.0}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{edge\PYGZus{}betweenness}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Active edges during [100, 200]: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Mean edge betweenness: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{edge\PYGZus{}betweenness}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.4f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Note on implementation status:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Temporal queries are \sphinxstylestrong{fully implemented} for edge\sphinxhyphen{}level temporal data. Node\sphinxhyphen{}level temporal filtering depends on your network’s representation:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
If nodes have explicit \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t}} attributes, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.at()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.during()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.before()}}, and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.after()}} work directly

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
If only edges are timestamped, node activity is inferred from edge presence

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For most use cases, temporal edge queries are sufficient

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{DSL Reference}}}} for complete temporal query syntax and examples with ISO date strings.


\subsubsection{Common Patterns}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:common-patterns}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This section presents \sphinxstylestrong{end\sphinxhyphen{}to\sphinxhyphen{}end recipes} for common multilayer network analysis tasks. These patterns are production\sphinxhyphen{}ready and can be adapted to your research questions.


\paragraph{Pattern: Find Influential Nodes}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:pattern-find-influential-nodes}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Identify nodes that are both well\sphinxhyphen{}connected (high degree) and structurally important (high betweenness centrality):

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} High\PYGZhy{}degree nodes ranked by betweenness centrality}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer\PYGZus{}count}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{20}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Top 20 influential nodes (degree \PYGZgt{} 10):}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer\PYGZus{}count}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export for further analysis or publication}
\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{influential\PYGZus{}nodes.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{index}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Visualize}
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{matplotlib}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{pyplot} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n+nn}{plt}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{figure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{figsize}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{6}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{scatter}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
            \PYG{n}{s}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer\PYGZus{}count}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{l+m+mi}{50}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{alpha}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.6}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{xlabel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{ylabel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Betweenness Centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{title}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Influential Nodes (size = layer\PYGZus{}count)}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{tight\PYGZus{}layout}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{savefig}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{influential\PYGZus{}nodes.png}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dpi}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{300}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Why this pattern works:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Degree} measures local connectivity (how many neighbors)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Betweenness centrality} measures global importance (how often the node appears on shortest paths)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Nodes high in both metrics are \sphinxstylestrong{influential bridges} in the network

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output:}

1   (alice, social)      12                 0.245000            2
2   (grace, social)      11                 0.221000            2
3     (bob, social)      12                 0.198000            1

...

\paragraph{Pattern: Compare Layer Activity}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:pattern-compare-layer-activity}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Compute summary statistics for each layer to understand layer\sphinxhyphen{}specific dynamics:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}stats} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{layer} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{append}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{num\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{max\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{max}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean\PYGZus{}clustering}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ nodes, }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
          \PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{avg degree=}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{, }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
          \PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{avg clustering=}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.3f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create comparison DataFrame}
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{pandas} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n+nn}{pd}
\PYG{n}{comparison} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Layer comparison:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{comparison}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Visualize}
\PYG{n}{comparison}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{plot}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{x}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{y}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean\PYGZus{}clustering}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
                \PYG{n}{kind}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{bar}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{figsize}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{ylabel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Value}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{title}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Layer Activity Comparison}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{xticks}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{rotation}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{45}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{tight\PYGZus{}layout}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{savefig}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer\PYGZus{}comparison.png}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dpi}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{300}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxstylestrong{Use case:} Understand how network structure varies across different contexts (e.g., online vs. offline interactions, different communication channels).

\paragraph{Pattern: Export Subnetwork}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:pattern-export-subnetwork}}

\paragraph{Pattern: Per\sphinxhyphen{}Layer Top\sphinxhyphen{}K with Coverage (Multi\sphinxhyphen{}Layer Hub Detection)}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:pattern-per-layer-top-k-with-coverage-multi-layer-hub-detection}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Find nodes that are top\sphinxhyphen{}k hubs (by any centrality metric) \sphinxstylestrong{across all layers}. This pattern is essential for identifying nodes that maintain high influence in the entire multilayer structure, not just in isolated layers.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{The Problem:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Traditional approaches require manual loops over layers:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Old approach: manual iteration}
\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}top} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{layer} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{res} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n+nb}{str}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}top}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{set}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{res}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{id}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Find intersection}
\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}hubs} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{set}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{intersection}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}top}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{values}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{The Solution: Grouping and Coverage API}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The new DSL supports per\sphinxhyphen{}layer operations in a single query:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Generate example network}
\PYG{n}{net} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{random\PYGZus{}generators}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{random\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}ER}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{n}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{200}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{l}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{p}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Find nodes that are top\PYGZhy{}5 betweenness hubs in ALL layers (single query!)}
\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}hubs} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}                   \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} wildcard: all layers}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}                           \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} group by layer}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} top 5 per layer}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{coverage}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{mode}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{all}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}                  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} nodes in top\PYGZhy{}5 in ALL layers}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{net}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}hubs}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Multi\PYGZhy{}layer hubs (in top\PYGZhy{}5 of ALL layers): }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{set}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Count: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{unique}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Detailed results:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}string}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\sphinxstylestrong{Coverage Modes:}

\sphinxstylestrong{Use Cases:}
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Identify persistent influencers}: Nodes that maintain high centrality across all contexts (layers)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Find layer specialists}: Nodes that are important in only one layer (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{mode="exact", k=1}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Detect multi\sphinxhyphen{}context bridges}: Nodes in top\sphinxhyphen{}k in at least 2 layers connect different contexts

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Community structure analysis}: Compare \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{mode="all"}} vs \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{mode="any"}} to understand layer cohesion

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Why This Pattern Matters:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
In real\sphinxhyphen{}world multilayer networks (social media, collaboration networks, biological systems), understanding \sphinxstylestrong{cross\sphinxhyphen{}layer} vs. \sphinxstylestrong{layer\sphinxhyphen{}specific} importance is crucial:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Email + Phone + Chat network}: Who are the omnipresent communicators vs. email\sphinxhyphen{}only specialists?

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Author collaboration network}: Who publishes top papers in multiple fields vs. specialists in one domain?

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Transportation network}: Which locations are hubs in all modes (bus, train, bike) vs. single\sphinxhyphen{}mode hubs?

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Performance Note:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The per\sphinxhyphen{}layer computation is optimized: measures are computed on the selected nodes after layer filtering, and grouping operations leverage efficient dictionaries. For large networks (\textgreater{}100K nodes), consider filtering with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{where()}} before computing expensive metrics like betweenness centrality.


\subsubsection{DSL Result Interoperability}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:dsl-result-interoperability}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
DSL query results integrate seamlessly with pandas for data transformation workflows. While QueryResult doesn’t implement pipeline verbs directly, it provides a clean \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.to\_pandas()}} export that enables the same workflow patterns:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Start with a DSL query to filter and compute metrics

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Export to pandas with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.to\_pandas()}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use pandas operations for additional transformations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Leverage the full pandas ecosystem for analysis and visualization

\end{enumerate}

\item {}
