\subsection{DSL Reference}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:dsl-reference}}\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Complete reference for the py3plex DSL (Domain\sphinxhyphen{}Specific Language) for querying multilayer networks.

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
For task\sphinxhyphen{}oriented usage, see {\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Query Multilayer Graphs with the SQL\sphinxhyphen{}like DSL}}}}.
This page is a complete reference with all syntax and operators.
\end{sphinxadmonition}


\subsubsection{Overview}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:overview}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The py3plex DSL provides two interfaces:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{String syntax:} SQL\sphinxhyphen{}like queries for quick exploration

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Builder API:} Type\sphinxhyphen{}safe Python interface for production code (autocomputes referenced metrics)

\end{enumerate}


\subsubsection{String Syntax Reference}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:string-syntax-reference}}

\paragraph{Basic Structure}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:basic-structure}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
SELECT \PYGZlt{}target\PYGZgt{} [FROM \PYGZlt{}layers\PYGZgt{}] [WHERE \PYGZlt{}conditions\PYGZgt{}] [COMPUTE \PYGZlt{}metrics\PYGZgt{}] [ORDER BY \PYGZlt{}field\PYGZgt{}] [LIMIT \PYGZlt{}n\PYGZgt{}]
[AT \PYGZlt{}timestamp\PYGZgt{} | DURING \PYGZlt{}start\PYGZgt{} TO \PYGZlt{}end\PYGZgt{}]
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{AT}} for a single time point and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{DURING}} for closed intervals (ISO 8601 strings).


\paragraph{Targets}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:targets}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{nodes}} — Select nodes

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{edges}} — Select edges (experimental; limited coverage support)

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Layer Selection}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:layer-selection}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
FROM layer=\PYGZdq{}layer\PYGZus{}name\PYGZdq{}
FROM layers IN (\PYGZdq{}layer1\PYGZdq{}, \PYGZdq{}layer2\PYGZdq{})
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
If \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{FROM}} is omitted, all layers are considered.


\paragraph{Conditions}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:conditions}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Operators:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{=}} — Equal

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textgreater{}}} — Greater than

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textless{}}} — Less than

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textgreater{}=}} — Greater than or equal

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textless{}=}} — Less than or equal

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{!=}} — Not equal

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Logical operators:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{AND}} — Both conditions must be true

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{OR}} — Either condition must be true

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{NOT}} — Negate a condition

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Examples:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
WHERE degree \PYGZgt{} 5
WHERE layer=\PYGZdq{}friends\PYGZdq{} AND degree \PYGZgt{} 3
WHERE degree \PYGZgt{} 5 OR betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality \PYGZgt{} 0.1
WHERE NOT layer=\PYGZdq{}spam\PYGZdq{}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
String values must be wrapped in double quotes.


\paragraph{Compute Clause}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:compute-clause}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate metrics for selected nodes:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
COMPUTE degree
COMPUTE degree betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality
COMPUTE clustering pagerank
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Available metrics:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree}} — Node degree

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{betweenness\_centrality}} — Betweenness centrality

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{closeness\_centrality}} — Closeness centrality

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{clustering}} — Clustering coefficient

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pagerank}} — PageRank score

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{layer\_count}} — Number of layers node appears in

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Metrics are computed after filtering and layer selection. See {\hyperref[\detokenize{reference/algorithm_reference::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{Algorithm Roadmap}}}} for the complete metric list.


\paragraph{Order By}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:order-by}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
ORDER BY degree
ORDER BY \PYGZhy{}degree  \PYGZsh{} Descending (prefix with \PYGZhy{})
ORDER BY betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
You can specify multiple keys in sequence; each key may be prefixed with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\sphinxhyphen{}}} for descending order.


\paragraph{Limit}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:limit}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
LIMIT 10
LIMIT 100
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Complete Examples}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:complete-examples}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{execute\PYGZus{}query}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get high\PYGZhy{}degree nodes}

    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{SELECT nodes WHERE degree \PYGZgt{} 5}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get nodes from specific layer}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{execute\PYGZus{}query}\PYG{p}{(}

    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{SELECT nodes FROM layer=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{friends}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{WHERE degree \PYGZgt{} 3 }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{COMPUTE betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ORDER BY \PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{LIMIT 10}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{n}{specialists} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{coverage}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{mode}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{exact}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{k}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Wildcard Layer Selection}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:wildcard-layer-selection}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L{[}"*"{]}}} to select all layers:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} All layers}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} All layers except \PYGZdq{}bots\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{bots}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Layer algebra still works}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{spam}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{\PYGZam{}} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{verified}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{General Grouping}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:general-grouping}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Group by arbitrary attributes (not just layer):

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Group by multiple attributes}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{community}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{group\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{community}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Limitations}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:limitations}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Coverage filtering is currently supported only for \sphinxstylestrong{node queries}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Edge queries with coverage will raise a clear \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{DslExecutionError}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Grouping requires computed attributes or inherent node properties (like layer)

\end{itemize}


\subsubsection{Working with Results}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:working-with-results}}

\paragraph{Result Object}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:result-object}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{execute}} returns a \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{QueryResult}} with items, computed attributes, and metadata:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Counts and identifiers}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{count}\PYG{p}{)}    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} \PYGZhy{}\PYGZgt{} number of nodes/edges}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} first few nodes (use .edges for edge queries)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Attributes are aligned lists keyed by metric name}
\PYG{n}{degrees} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{attributes}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{deg} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n+nb}{zip}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{degrees}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{deg}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Execution metadata (e.g., grouping, ordering)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{meta}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Convert to Pandas}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:convert-to-pandas}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{multiindex}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{include\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{head}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Set \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{expand\_uncertainty=True}} to unpack UQ\sphinxhyphen{}aware metrics into multiple columns.


\subsubsection{Extensibility}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:extensibility}}

\paragraph{Custom Operators}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:custom-operators}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Register custom DSL operators:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{register\PYGZus{}operator}

\PYG{n+nd}{@register\PYGZus{}operator}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{my\PYGZus{}metric}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{def} \PYG{n+nf}{my\PYGZus{}custom\PYGZus{}metric}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{context}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{l+s+sd}{\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}Compute custom metric for a node.\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}\PYGZdq{}}
    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Your implementation}
    \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{value}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{dev/code_architecture::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{Architecture and Design}}}} for plugin development.


\subsubsection{Performance Considerations}
\label{\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference:performance-considerations}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Compute metrics once:} Don’t recompute in multiple queries

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Filter early:} Use WHERE before COMPUTE

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Limit results:} Use LIMIT for large networks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layer\sphinxhyphen{}specific:} Query single layers when possible

\end{enumerate}

\subsection{Layer Set Algebra}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:layer-set-algebra}}\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The Layer Set Algebra feature provides a first\sphinxhyphen{}class, composable system for
selecting and manipulating layer sets in multilayer networks. Instead of manually
specifying lists of layers, you can use set\sphinxhyphen{}theoretic operations to express
complex layer selections.


\subsubsection{Why Layer Set Algebra?}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:why-layer-set-algebra}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
In multilayer network analysis, you often need to:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Select “all layers except the coupling layer”

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Combine biological layers for aggregate analysis

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Find the intersection of layers where a node appears

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Reuse layer group definitions across multiple queries

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The Layer Set Algebra makes these operations expressive, composable, and safe.


\subsubsection{Quick Start}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:quick-start}}

\paragraph{Basic Operations}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:basic-operations}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{LayerSet}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Q}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create layer sets}
\PYG{n}{social} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{LayerSet}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{work} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{LayerSet}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Union: layers in either social OR work}
\PYG{n}{both} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{social} \PYG{o}{|} \PYG{n}{work}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Intersection: layers in both social AND work}
\PYG{n}{shared} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{social} \PYG{o}{\PYGZam{}} \PYG{n}{work}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Difference: layers in social but NOT in work}
\PYG{n}{social\PYGZus{}only} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{social} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}} \PYG{n}{work}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Complement: all layers EXCEPT social}
\PYG{n}{not\PYGZus{}social} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{o}{\PYGZti{}}\PYG{n}{social}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{String Expressions}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:string-expressions}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
For convenience, you can write layer expressions as strings:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Parse from string}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{LayerSet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{parse}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{* \PYGZhy{} coupling}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Or use L[...] syntax (auto\PYGZhy{}detects expressions)}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{* \PYGZhy{} coupling}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{(ppi | gene) \PYGZam{} disease}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social | work | hobby}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Integration with Queries}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:integration-with-queries}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use layer sets in any DSL query:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Query nodes from all layers except coupling}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{* \PYGZhy{} coupling}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Complex layer selection}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{(social | work) \PYGZam{} \PYGZti{}coupling}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Set Operations}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:set-operations}}

\paragraph{Union: A | B}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:union-a-b}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The union operation combines layers from multiple sets.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Select nodes from social OR work layers}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social | work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Equivalent to:}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{LayerSet}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{o}{|} \PYG{n}{LayerSet}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{ASCII Venn Diagram:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
┌─────────┐     ┌─────────┐
│ Social  │     │  Work   │
│    ┌────┴─────┴────┐    │
│    │   RESULT      │    │
└────┴────────────────┴────┘
   A | B = \PYGZob{}social, work\PYGZcb{}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Intersection: A \& B}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:intersection-a-b}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The intersection operation selects only layers present in both sets.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Nodes that appear in both layer A AND layer B}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layerA \PYGZam{} layerB}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{ASCII Venn Diagram:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
┌─────────┐     ┌─────────┐
│    A    │     │    B    │
│    ┌────┼─────┼────┐    │
│    │    │ RES │    │    │
└────┴────┼─────┼────┴────┘
          A \PYGZam{} B
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Difference: A \sphinxhyphen{} B}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:difference-a-b}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The difference operation removes layers in B from A.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} All layers except coupling}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{* \PYGZhy{} coupling}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Social layers but not bots}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social \PYGZhy{} bots}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{ASCII Venn Diagram:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
┌─────────┐     ┌─────────┐
│    A    │     │    B    │
│  ┌──────┼─────┤         │
│  │ RES  │     │         │
└──┴──────┼─────┴─────────┘
   A \PYGZhy{} B = A without B
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Complement: \textasciitilde{}A}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:complement-a}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The complement operation returns all layers except those in A.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Everything except social layer}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{o}{\PYGZti{}}\PYG{n}{LayerSet}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Equivalent to:}

\subsubsection{Operator Precedence}

\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Complement} (\textasciitilde{}) \sphinxhyphen{} highest precedence

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Intersection} (\&)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Difference} (\sphinxhyphen{})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Union} (|) \sphinxhyphen{} lowest precedence

\end{enumerate}

\PYG{n}{expr3} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{A \PYGZam{} (B | C)}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}

\subsubsection{Why Layer Set Algebra Matters}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:why-layer-set-algebra-matters}}

\paragraph{For Multilayer Networks}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:for-multilayer-networks}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Multilayer networks have a unique challenge: layer selection is a first\sphinxhyphen{}class
operation, not an afterthought. Traditional graph analysis tools don’t provide
built\sphinxhyphen{}in support for layer algebra, forcing users to write imperative code
with loops and conditionals.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Layer Set Algebra brings the following benefits:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expressiveness}: Complex layer selections become one\sphinxhyphen{}liners

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Composability}: Combine layer expressions with set operations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Reusability}: Define named groups once, use everywhere

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Safety}: Late evaluation with validation at execution time

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Maintainability}: Clear, declarative code is easier to understand

\end{enumerate}


\paragraph{Algebraic Properties}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:algebraic-properties}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Layer Set Algebra follows standard set theory laws:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Idempotence}: A | A = A, A \& A = A

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Commutativity}: A | B = B | A, A \& B = B \& A

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Associativity}: (A | B) | C = A | (B | C)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Distributivity}: A \& (B | C) = (A \& B) | (A \& C)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{De Morgan’s Laws}: \textasciitilde{}(A | B) = \textasciitilde{}A \& \textasciitilde{}B, \textasciitilde{}(A \& B) = \textasciitilde{}A | \textasciitilde{}B

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Complement}: A | \textasciitilde{}A = {\color{red}\bfseries{}*}, A \& \textasciitilde{}A = ∅

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
These properties enable query optimization and reasoning about layer selections.

\subsubsection{Troubleshooting}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:troubleshooting}}

\paragraph{Common Issues}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:common-issues}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{1. Empty Layer Set Warning}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{nonexistent}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{resolve}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} UserWarning: Layer expression resolved to empty set}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solution}: Check layer names, use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{warn\_empty=False}} to suppress, or use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{strict=True}} to raise an error instead.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{2. Unknown Layer Error}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{typo\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{resolve}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{strict}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} UnknownLayerError: Layer \PYGZsq{}typo\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZsq{} not found}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solution}: Verify layer names with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{network.layers}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{network.get\_layers()}}.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{3. Syntax Error in Expression}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social \PYGZam{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Missing right operand}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} DslSyntaxError: Unexpected end of expression}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Solution}: Check expression syntax, ensure all operators have operands.


\paragraph{Best Practices}
\label{\detokenize{reference/layer_set_algebra:best-practices}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use Named Groups} for complex layer sets you’ll reuse

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Prefer String Expressions} for readability: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L{[}"* \sphinxhyphen{} coupling"{]}}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use Complement} instead of listing all other layers: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textasciitilde{}LayerSet("exclude")}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Document Layer Groups} with comments explaining their purpose

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Test Layer Resolution} with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.explain(network)}} before running expensive queries

\end{enumerate}

\subsection{Uncertainty\sphinxhyphen{}First Statistics}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:uncertainty-first-statistics}}\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics::doc}}

\subsubsection{Overview}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:overview}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
py3plex implements an \sphinxstylestrong{uncertainty\sphinxhyphen{}first statistics system} where every statistic is represented as \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{(value + uncertainty + provenance)}}. This design makes uncertainty a core part of statistics computation, not an afterthought.


\paragraph{Key Principles}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:key-principles}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Every statistic is a StatValue}: No plain floats/ints escaping internal computation paths. Even deterministic values carry \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Delta(0)}} uncertainty.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Uncertainty is first\sphinxhyphen{}class}: Uncertainty can be summarized, sampled, propagated through arithmetic, and used in queries.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Backward compatible}: Existing code expecting floats works via \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{float(statvalue)}}.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Registry discipline}: Statistics must have an uncertainty model to be registered.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Reproducible}: Random processes (bootstrap/MC) support explicit seeds tracked in provenance.

\end{enumerate}


\subsubsection{Core Components}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:core-components}}

\paragraph{StatValue}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:statvalue}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{StatValue}} is the fundamental container for statistics:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{stats} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{StatValue}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Delta}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Provenance}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create a deterministic statistic}
\PYG{n}{sv} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{StatValue}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{value}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.42}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{uncertainty}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{Delta}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{provenance}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{Provenance}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{delta}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Access value}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{float}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{sv}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 0.42}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Query uncertainty}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{sv}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{std}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 0.0}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{sv}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{ci}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.95}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} (0.42, 0.42)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{sv}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{robustness}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 1.0}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Key Methods:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{float(sv)}}: Convert to point estimate (backward compatibility)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{sv.mean()}}: Alias for value

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{sv.std()}}: Standard deviation

\item {}

\paragraph{Uncertainty Models}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:uncertainty-models}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Five concrete uncertainty models are provided:


\subparagraph{Delta}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:delta}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Deterministic or known\sphinxhyphen{}precision uncertainty.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{stats} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Delta}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Perfect certainty}
\PYG{n}{d} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Delta}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Small known error}
\PYG{n}{d} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Delta}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.01}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Properties:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{std()}}: Returns sigma

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ci(level)}}: Returns symmetric interval based on sigma

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{sample(n, seed)}}: Returns constant samples

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Propagation: Analytic error propagation when both are Delta

\end{itemize}


\subparagraph{Gaussian}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:gaussian}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Normal distribution uncertainty.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{stats} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Gaussian}

\PYG{n}{g} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Gaussian}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{std\PYGZus{}dev}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Exact CI computation}
\PYG{n}{low}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{high} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{g}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{ci}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.95}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} ≈ (\PYGZhy{}0.196, 0.196)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Properties:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{std()}}: Returns std\_dev

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ci(level)}}: Exact Gaussian CI using z\sphinxhyphen{}scores

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{sample(n, seed)}}: Generates Gaussian samples

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Propagation: Analytic for addition/subtraction, Monte Carlo for complex ops

\end{itemize}


\subparagraph{Bootstrap}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:bootstrap}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Empirical uncertainty from bootstrap resampling.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{stats} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Bootstrap}
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{numpy} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n+nn}{np}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Store bootstrap samples (relative to point estimate)}
\PYG{n}{samples} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{np}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{array}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.15}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.08}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{b} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Bootstrap}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{samples}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compute CI from percentiles}
\PYG{n}{low}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{high} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{b}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{ci}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.95}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Properties:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{std()}}: Sample standard deviation

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ci(level)}}: Percentile\sphinxhyphen{}based CI

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{sample(n, seed)}}: Resample from stored samples

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Propagation: Always Monte Carlo

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Serialization: Stores summary (n, std, CI) not full samples

\end{itemize}


\subparagraph{Empirical}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:empirical}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Similar to Bootstrap but conceptually for any empirical distribution.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{n}{e} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Empirical}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{samples}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Properties:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar

\end{itemize}


\subparagraph{Interval}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:interval}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Interval\sphinxhyphen{}based uncertainty without assuming distribution.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{n}{i} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Interval}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.15}\PYG{p}{)}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Statistics Registry}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:statistics-registry}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{StatisticsRegistry}} enforces that every registered statistic has an uncertainty model.


\paragraph{Registration}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:registration}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{stats} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{StatisticSpec}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{register\PYGZus{}statistic}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Delta}

\PYG{k}{def} \PYG{n+nf}{degree\PYGZus{}uncertainty}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{o}{*}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{kwargs}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{k}{return} \PYG{n}{Delta}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Deterministic}

\PYG{n}{spec} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{StatisticSpec}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{name}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{estimator}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{compute\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{uncertainty\PYGZus{}model}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}uncertainty}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{assumptions}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{deterministic}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{supports}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{directed}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{weighted}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{register\PYGZus{}statistic}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{spec}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Note:} Registration fails if \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{uncertainty\_model}} is missing.

\subsubsection{Arithmetic with Uncertainty}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:arithmetic-with-uncertainty}}

StatValue supports arithmetic operations with automatic uncertainty propagation.

\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:basic-operations}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{stats} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{StatValue}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Gaussian}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Provenance}

\PYG{n}{sv2} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{StatValue}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{2.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Gaussian}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.15}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Provenance}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{b}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{gaussian}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Addition}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{float}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 3.0}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{std}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} \PYGZti{}0.180 (sqrt(0.1\(\sp{\text{2}}\) + 0.15\(\sp{\text{2}}\)))}

\paragraph{Scalar Operations}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:scalar-operations}}

StatValue supports operations with scalars:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{sv} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{StatValue}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{2.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Gaussian}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{Provenance}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{gaussian}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Scalar addition}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Scalar multiplication}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{sv} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{l+m+mi}{2}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 4.0 (uncertainty scaled)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Scalar division}

\paragraph{Propagation Rules}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:propagation-rules}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Delta + Delta}: Analytic error propagation (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{σ\_sum = sqrt(σ1\(\sp{\text{2}}\) + σ2\(\sp{\text{2}}\))}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Gaussian + Gaussian}: Exact propagation for addition/subtraction

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Complex operations}: Monte Carlo propagation (4096 samples by default)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Scalar operations}: Direct computation, uncertainty scaled appropriately

\end{enumerate}


\subsubsection{Filtering and Queries}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:filtering-and-queries}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Statistics with uncertainty can be filtered using selectors:


\paragraph{Selector Syntax}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:selector-syntax}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Format: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{attribute\_\_component\_\_operator=value}}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Components:}
\begin{itemize}

\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{mean}}: Point estimate (default if omitted)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{std}}: Standard deviation

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ci95\_\_width}}: Width of 95\% CI

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{robustness}}: Robustness score

\end{itemize}

\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Best Practices}
\label{\detokenize{reference/uncertainty_first_statistics:best-practices}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Always use StatValue internally}: Even for deterministic stats, use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Delta(0)}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Provide uncertainty models}: Every registered statistic must have one

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use seeds for reproducibility}: Pass explicit seeds to bootstrap/MC operations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Choose appropriate models}:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Deterministic \(\rightarrow\) \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Delta(0)}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Known distribution \(\rightarrow\) \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Gaussian}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Empirical estimation \(\rightarrow\) \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Bootstrap}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Empirical}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
No distribution assumption \(\rightarrow\) \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Interval}}

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Check robustness}: Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{sv.robustness()}} to assess reliability

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Export uncertainty}: Include uncertainty columns in exports for downstream analysis

\end{enumerate}

\subsection{Configuration \& Environment}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:configuration-environment}}\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This page collects the practical knobs for running py3plex: configuration files, environment variables, supported I/O formats, and common algorithm parameters.


\subsubsection{Configuration Files}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:configuration-files}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
py3plex supports configuration files for reproducible workflows. Provide them as YAML or JSON; omit sections you do not need.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Network Configuration (YAML):}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} network\PYGZus{}config.yaml}
\PYG{n+nt}{network}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{input\PYGZus{}file}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s}{data/multilayer.edges}\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s}{multiedgelist}\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} one of: multiedgelist, edgelist, json, graphml, parquet}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{directed}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{false}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{weighted}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{true}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} field meanings:}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} input\PYGZus{}file: path to your dataset}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} input\PYGZus{}type: parser to use (match the file format)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} directed/weighted: toggle graph properties}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Load with:}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} network.load\PYGZus{}network(**config[\PYGZsq{}network\PYGZsq{}])}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Algorithm Parameters:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} algorithm\PYGZus{}config.yaml}
\PYG{n+nt}{community\PYGZus{}detection}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{algorithm}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s}{louvain\PYGZus{}multilayer}\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{params}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{n+nt}{gamma}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{1.0}\PYG{+w}{          }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} resolution; higher favors smaller communities}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{n+nt}{omega}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{0.5}\PYG{+w}{          }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} inter\PYGZhy{}layer coupling strength}
\PYG{+w}{    }\PYG{n+nt}{random\PYGZus{}state}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{42}

\PYG{n+nt}{node2vec}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{dimensions}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{128}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{walk\PYGZus{}length}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{80}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{num\PYGZus{}walks}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{10}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{p}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{1.0}\PYG{+w}{               }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} return hyperparameter (p \PYGZgt{} 1 biases against revisiting)}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{q}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{1.0}\PYG{+w}{               }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} in\PYGZhy{}out hyperparameter (q \PYGZlt{} 1 encourages outward exploration)}

\PYG{n+nt}{dynamics}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{model}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s}{SIR}\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{beta}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{0.3}\PYG{+w}{            }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} infection probability per contact}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{gamma}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{0.1}\PYG{+w}{           }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} recovery probability}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{initial\PYGZus{}infected}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{0.05}\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} fraction of nodes initially infected (0\textendash{}1)}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{steps}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{100}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Section meanings:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{community\_detection}} — choose algorithm and pass algorithm\sphinxhyphen{}specific params

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{node2vec}} — structural embedding hyperparameters (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{p}}/\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{q}} control walk bias)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{dynamics}} — compartmental model parameters; \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{initial\_infected}} expects a fraction

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Visualization Settings:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} viz\PYGZus{}config.yaml}
\PYG{n+nt}{visualization}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{layout}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s}{force\PYGZus{}directed}\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{node\PYGZus{}size}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{50}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{edge\PYGZus{}width}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{2}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{dpi}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{300}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{output\PYGZus{}format}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s}{png}\PYG{l+s}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{+w}{  }\PYG{n+nt}{color\PYGZus{}by\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+lScalar+lScalarPlain}{true}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Loading configuration:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{yaml}
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Load config}
\PYG{k}{with} \PYG{n+nb}{open}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{config.yaml}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{r}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n}{f}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{config} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{yaml}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{safe\PYGZus{}load}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{f}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Use config}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{config}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{directed}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{config}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{input\PYGZus{}file}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{config}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{network}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Environment Variables}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:environment-variables}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
py3plex respects the following environment variables for customization. Override them in your shell before running scripts or set them in code via \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{os.environ}}.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Data Directories:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PY3PLEX\_DATA\_DIR}} — Override default data directory location
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Default: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textasciitilde{}/.py3plex/data}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Used for: Cached datasets, downloaded networks

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PY3PLEX\_CACHE\_DIR}} — Cache directory for computed results
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Default: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\textasciitilde{}/.py3plex/cache}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Used for: Embedding caches, computation results

\end{itemize}

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Performance Tuning:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PY3PLEX\_NUM\_WORKERS}} — Suggested number of parallel workers for algorithms
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Default recommendation: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{os.cpu\_count()}} when you wire this through to APIs

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Effect: only applied by functions/scripts that read the variable

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PY3PLEX\_MEMORY\_LIMIT}} — Optional memory budget for large\sphinxhyphen{}scale operations (in GB)
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Default: unset (falls back to library defaults)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Effect: honored only by routines that support explicit memory caps

\end{itemize}

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Setting environment variables:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Linux/macOS}
\PYG{n+nb}{export}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nv}{PY3PLEX\PYGZus{}DATA\PYGZus{}DIR}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}/path/to/data\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{n+nb}{export}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nv}{PY3PLEX\PYGZus{}NUM\PYGZus{}WORKERS}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m}{8}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Or in Python}
import\PYG{+w}{ }os
os.environ\PYG{o}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}PY3PLEX\PYGZus{}DATA\PYGZus{}DIR\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{o}{]}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}/path/to/data\PYGZsq{}}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Debugging and Development:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PY3PLEX\_DEBUG}} — Enable debug mode (verbose output)
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Values: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{0}} (off), \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{1}} (on)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Default: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{0}}

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PY3PLEX\_PROFILE}} — Enable profiling for performance analysis
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Values: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{0}} (off), \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{1}} (on)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Default: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{0}}

\end{itemize}

\end{itemize}


\subsubsection{Input Formats}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:input-formats}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Supported file formats:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{multiedgelist}} — Multilayer edge list format with layer annotations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{edgelist}} — Standard edge list (single layer)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{json}} — JSON network format produced by py3plex tools

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{graphml}} — GraphML format for interoperability with NetworkX/Gephi

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{parquet}} — Apache Parquet for columnar, high\sphinxhyphen{}performance I/O

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Load and Build Networks}}}} for format details.


\subsubsection{Output Formats}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:output-formats}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Networks can be exported to:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Pickle (Python serialization)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
JSON

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
CSV/TSV

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
GraphML

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Parquet

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/export_serialize::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Export and Serialize Networks}}}} for export details.


\subsubsection{Algorithm Configuration}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:algorithm-configuration}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Many algorithms accept configuration parameters. The snippets below show common defaults and what each parameter controls.


\paragraph{Community Detection}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:community-detection}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{algorithms}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{community\PYGZus{}detection} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multilayer\PYGZus{}louvain}

\PYG{n}{communities} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multilayer\PYGZus{}louvain}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{resolution}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Higher \(\rightarrow\) more, smaller communities}
    \PYG{n}{omega}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.5}        \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Inter\PYGZhy{}layer coupling strength}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Node2Vec}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:node2vec}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{wrappers} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{train\PYGZus{}node2vec}

\PYG{n}{embeddings} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{train\PYGZus{}node2vec}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{dimensions}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{128}\PYG{p}{,}      \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Embedding size}
    \PYG{n}{walk\PYGZus{}length}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{80}\PYG{p}{,}      \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Steps per walk}
    \PYG{n}{num\PYGZus{}walks}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,}        \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Walks per node}
    \PYG{n}{p}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,}               \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Return parameter (larger discourages backtracking)}
    \PYG{n}{q}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{,}               \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} In\PYGZhy{}out parameter (smaller explores outward)}
    \PYG{n}{workers}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{4}            \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Parallel workers}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Dynamics}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:dynamics}}
\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dynamics} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{SIRDynamics}

    \PYG{n}{beta}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3}\PYG{p}{,}            \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Infection probability per contact}
    \PYG{n}{gamma}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}\PYG{p}{,}           \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Recovery probability per step}
    \PYG{n}{initial\PYGZus{}infected}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Fraction of nodes initially infected (0\textendash{}1)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Logging Configuration}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:logging-configuration}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
py3plex uses Python’s standard \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{logging}} module. Configure logging for debugging and monitoring:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Basic Logging Setup:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{logging}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Set log level}
\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{basicConfig}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{level}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{INFO}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n+nb}{format}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(asctime)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ \PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(name)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ \PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(levelname)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ \PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(message)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Now py3plex operations will log to console}
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} ... logs will appear}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Log Levels:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{DEBUG}} — Detailed information, typically of interest only when diagnosing problems

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{INFO}} — Confirmation that things are working as expected (default)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{WARNING}} — An indication that something unexpected happened

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ERROR}} — A more serious problem, the software has not been able to perform some function

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{CRITICAL}} — A serious error, the program may be unable to continue running

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Log to File:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{logging}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Configure file handler}
\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{basicConfig}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{level}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DEBUG}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n+nb}{format}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(asctime)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ \PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(name)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ \PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(levelname)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ \PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(message)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{handlers}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}
        \PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{FileHandler}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{py3plex.log}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{StreamHandler}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Also log to console}
    \PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Log File Location:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
By default, logs are written to:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Console (stdout) when using \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{StreamHandler}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Custom file when using \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{FileHandler}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Environment variable \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PY3PLEX\_LOG\_FILE}} can override default location

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Component\sphinxhyphen{}Specific Logging:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Enable debug logging only for specific components}

\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{getLogger}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{py3plex.dsl}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{setLevel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{INFO}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{getLogger}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{py3plex.dynamics}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{setLevel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{WARNING}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Custom Logging Handlers:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
For advanced use cases (e.g., sending logs to external systems):

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{logging}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{handlers} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{RotatingFileHandler}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Rotating file handler (10MB max, keep 5 backups)}

    \PYG{n}{maxBytes}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1024}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1024}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{backupCount}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}
\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{handler}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{setLevel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DEBUG}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{handler}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{setFormatter}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{Formatter}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(asctime)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ \PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(name)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ \PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(levelname)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{ \PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZpc{}(message)s}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Add to py3plex logger}
\PYG{n}{logger} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{getLogger}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{py3plex}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{logger}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{addHandler}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{handler}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{logger}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{setLevel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{logging}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DEBUG}\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Performance Tuning}
\label{\detokenize{reference/configuration:performance-tuning}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Quick levers:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Match \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PY3PLEX\_NUM\_WORKERS}} to available cores when parallelism is supported.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{parquet}} I/O for large networks to reduce load time.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Set \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PY3PLEX\_MEMORY\_LIMIT}} when supported to avoid oversubscription on shared machines.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{project/benchmarking::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{Benchmarking \& Performance}}}} for performance optimization strategies.

\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{visualization}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{multilayer} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}

    \PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{list}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\subsubsection{Contributing Examples}
\label{\detokenize{examples/index:contributing-examples}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
To contribute an example:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Create a well\sphinxhyphen{}documented script in the appropriate \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{examples/\textless{}category\textgreater{}/}} directory.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use the template above with docstring + \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{main()}} + \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{if \_\_name\_\_ == "\_\_main\_\_":}}.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Follow the naming convention: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{example\_\textless{}feature\textgreater{}.py}}.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Test that it runs without errors from the repository root.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Add it to this index with a brief description under the correct topic.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Submit a pull request.

\end{enumerate}

\subsection{Analysis Recipes \& Workflows}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/recipes_and_workflows:analysis-recipes-workflows}}\label{\detokenize{user_guide/recipes_and_workflows:recipes}}\label{\detokenize{user_guide/recipes_and_workflows::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This guide provides \sphinxstylestrong{practical recipes} for \sphinxstylestrong{common analysis workflows} in py3plex.
Each recipe is a \sphinxstylestrong{complete, ready\sphinxhyphen{}to\sphinxhyphen{}use solution} for a real\sphinxhyphen{}world task.

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{DSL for Rapid Analysis}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Many recipes can be expressed concisely using the DSL:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Quick hub identification}
\PYG{n}{hubs} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Multi\PYGZhy{}layer comparison}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}name} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{family}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}name}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}name}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{count}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ nodes}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\subsubsection{Data Import \& Setup}

\paragraph{Recipe 1: Load Network from Multiple File Formats}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/recipes_and_workflows:recipe-1-load-network-from-multiple-file-formats}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Task:} Load \sphinxstylestrong{multilayer networks} from various \sphinxstylestrong{file formats} (edgelist, GraphML, CSV).

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Script:} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{examples/io\_and\_data/example\_IO.py}}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} From multiedgelist (node1, layer1, node2, layer2, weight)}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{data/network.txt}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{multiedgelist}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} From GraphML}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{data/network.graphml}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{input\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{graphml}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} From edges list programmatically}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{collections} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Counter}

\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{load\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}

\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} omega: inter\PYGZhy{}layer coupling strength (higher = communities span layers)}
\PYG{n}{partition} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{louvain\PYGZus{}multilayer}\PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{,}

\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Check which nodes are in largest community}
\PYG{n}{largest\PYGZus{}comm} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{community\PYGZus{}sizes}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{most\PYGZus{}common}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mi}{0}\PYG{p}{]}

                      \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{comm} \PYG{o}{==} \PYG{n}{largest\PYGZus{}comm}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Nodes in largest community: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{largest\PYGZus{}comm\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{:}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{...}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{p}{]}

\paragraph{Recipe 16: Handle Large Networks Efficiently}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/recipes_and_workflows:recipe-16-handle-large-networks-efficiently}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Task:} Process large multilayer networks without running out of memory.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}
\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n+nn}{gc}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} === 1. Load network efficiently ===}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Use generators instead of loading all at once}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} For very large files, load in chunks or stream}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} (This is a conceptual example \PYGZhy{} actual implementation may vary)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} === 2. Process layers independently ===}
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}results} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}name} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Processing layer }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}name}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{...}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Extract and process one layer at a time}
    \PYG{n}{layer} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{subnetwork}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}name}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{subset\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layers}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compute statistics for this layer}
    \PYG{n}{nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{list}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{edges} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{list}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}results}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n+nb}{str}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}name}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{nodes}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{edges}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}

\paragraph{General Tips}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/recipes_and_workflows:general-tips}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Always set random seeds} for reproducibility:

\paragraph{Performance Tips}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/recipes_and_workflows:performance-tips}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{For large networks}, process layers independently

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use sparse matrices} when working with supra\sphinxhyphen{}adjacency

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Sample networks} for visualization (\textgreater{}1000 nodes gets crowded)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Profile your code} to find bottlenecks

\paragraph{Visualization Tips}

\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {}

\sphinxstylestrong{Choose layout carefully}:
\begin{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Circular: Fast, good for small networks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Spring: Balance between quality and speed

\sphinxAtStartPar

\paragraph{Community Detection Tips}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/recipes_and_workflows:community-detection-tips}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Tune resolution parameter} (gamma):
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Higher gamma \(\rightarrow\) more, smaller communities

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Lower gamma \(\rightarrow\) fewer, larger communities

\end{itemize}

\item {}

     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{20}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{export\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{top\PYGZus{}hubs.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Display results}

\PYG{n}{work\PYGZus{}hubs} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{find\PYGZus{}top\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{work}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{20}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Recipe 22: DSL with EXPLAIN Mode}
\label{\detokenize{user_guide/recipes_and_workflows:recipe-22-dsl-with-explain-mode}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Task:} Optimize queries before execution on large networks.

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{DSL Example: Query Optimization}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from} \PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl} \PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Build a potentially expensive query}
\PYG{n}{query} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} O(n\(\sp{\text{3}}\)) operation!}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Check the execution plan first}
\PYG{n}{plan} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{query}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{explain}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Query Execution Plan:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{step} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{plan}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{steps}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{} }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{step}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{description}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{  Complexity: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{step}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{estimated\PYGZus{}complexity}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Check for warnings}
\PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{plan}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{warnings}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Warnings:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{warning} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{plan}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{warnings}\PYG{p}{:}
        \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{⚠️  }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{warning}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Optimized version: filter first to reduce computation}
\PYG{n}{optimized\PYGZus{}query} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Pre\PYGZhy{}filter to reduce nodes}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Execute the optimized query}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{optimized\PYGZus{}query}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
